Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Generation Quality Check Screen: Insert a dedicated photo quality check screen right after photo upload to preview photo lighting and facial feature extraction before model generation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, causing user churn during adoption.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Interactive Mascot Walkthrough: Introduce a guided companion walkthrough component on the home intro screen detailing shortcut hotkeys, hiding modes, and chat controls. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or speak to the pet post-onboarding, contributing to a low 64.8% finish step completion.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Stage Status Counter: Display granular rendering sub-task status updates (engine initialization, desktop bounds check, 3D asset loading) on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s (median 201s) and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to spawn or open on desktop.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness System Sound Alert: Add an optional audio chime notification and completion badge to the waiting screen when asset rendering finishes. (why: Users wait a median of 201s during rendering and may look away from the screen, missing when their pet arrives.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Hotkeys Summary Copy: Add concise copy outlining core desktop interaction hotkeys directly on the final welcome banner. (why: Multiple support emails expressed post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding or interacting with the pet.)
5: [adoption, hint] Pet Customization Photo Lighting Guidance Hint: Add a photo upload tip carousel hint explaining ideal lighting conditions and head angles for accurate pet generation. (why: Custom pet generation errors lead to drop-offs at adoption (63.2%) and produce support complaints about wrong pet appearances.)
